units: metres, degrees; quaternions wxyz; body frame = mesh frame (origin bottom centre); each pose yaw puts the long side of its footprint on world X

method.com: area-weighted centroid of the mesh triangles (uniform thin shell)
method.collision: MuJoCo convex hull of each mesh
method.probability: quasi-static: solid angle of hull facets seen from the COM
method.drops: 200 random orientations, 10-20 mm above the table, simulated to rest
method.verify: 5 s hold: drift < 0.5 mm, rotation < 1.0 deg, speed < 0.1 mm/s; plate = flat box with the KALAS floor geom values
method.marginal: tipped after a 2.0 deg tilt in one of 12 directions on the table or the plate
method.grasp: top-down parallel jaws closing horizontally; width 10-45 mm; flat parallel contact over +/-3 mm; no overhang above the grasp; height >= 8 mm, near half the part height; yaw = closing axis from world +X in the stored pose
